title: Suno's AI music training faces novel US challenge by musicians Isbell, Lowery
why_it_matters_hint: Headline only: musicians are said to be mounting a novel US challenge to how Suno trains its AI music.
notes: MLex is paywalled (only subscription boilerplate came back). The only other readable item was lawnews.co.uk (1 Oct 2026), a small outlet of uncertain reliability whose page reads like an unsigned commentary; it says Jason Isbell and other musicians (David Lowery, Carly Simon, Buddy Guy, Common and others) filed a class action against Suno in federal court in Massachusetts, dated 1 Sep 2026 in its text, arguing Suno took their names and voices (a 'musical identity' claim) rather than copying particular songs, and that federal copyright preemption is the main hurdle. Not verified elsewhere and not used for the entry. Headline only.
